name: 09-receive-the-pokedex
objective: Go into Oak's laboratory and talk to him with the parcel in your bag. He takes it, your rival arrives, and Oak gives you both the Pokedex — one script sets EVENT_GOT_POKEDEX and EVENT_OAK_GOT_PARCEL together. The Pokedex is what makes the old man in Viridian move aside, so this leg is the real gate on the road north.
evidence: watch:got_pokedex!=0 — EVENT_GOT_POKEDEX, event index 37, so wEventFlags $D74B bit 5, walked out of pokered's constants/event_constants.asm const list. OaksLabOakGivesPokedexScript (scripts/OaksLab.asm) ends `SetEvent EVENT_GOT_POKEDEX / SetEvent EVENT_OAK_GOT_PARCEL` — the two are set together, so the flag records the whole handover and not merely the parcel changing hands.

and it is the real gate on the road north, at one tile. ViridianCityCheckGotPokedexScript opens `CheckEvent EVENT_GOT_POKEDEX / ret nz`, so with the flag set it returns at once; without it, and only when wYCoord is 9 and wXCoord is 19, the old man's text plays and ViridianCityMovePlayerDownScript pushes the player back. So the block is that single tile rather than the whole road — a fact worth having before anyone routes around it.
failure party_hp=0 — the same judgement as link 06, and the same cartridge fact behind it: Pallet Town's approach carries grass and a blackout there is a real one.
